title: Chapter portals
detail: The floor pads became glowing doorways showing the next chapter. Click or tap to walk over, then stand still to charge; stepping away cancels.

title: Art direction: GPT-6 Astra
detail: “I only allowed GPT-6 Astra to generate art. The other models lowkey... are chopped as h3ll” — Vero

title: A scrollable change log
detail: Major changes and decisions now live in one file. What changed shows a few entries at a time, with more as you scroll inside the log.

title: Charge-up
detail: A sound plays while you hold to enter, and a different sound plays while you stand on the floor pad. Letting go stops it. The scene change stays quiet.

title: How the page is built
detail: Closed until the title is clicked. It stays on this page.

title: Sound
detail: Bohemian Fairy stays silent until a chapter has been opened once. Quick View does not start a song. The closet and the cubicle share one track.

title: Floor pad
detail: Gameplay. Hold still to go to the next chapter. The button stays. The last chapter has no pad.

title: Gameplay, keys
detail: Space, Shift+Space, hold E, Esc. The line stays on the timeline. The first Space from the top goes to College.

title: Password line
detail: “ACCESS GRANTED / a classic 🪄♟️”. A wrong password is “ACCESS DENIED”. The chess scene is not built.

title: Voice
detail: Tell the events specifically. Do not invent a career thesis.

title: Two readers
detail: Voice drafts. Recruiter Editor flags a 45-second skim. Vero decides.

title: Five chapters
detail: College, JPMorgan Chase, Fortress, the café, and game development. Any chapter is open.

title: Opening order
detail: Journey index, then the apartment, then Quick View. The number strip is gone.

title: Quick View
detail: A closeable overlay. The map opens the chapter in view.

title: Overworld
detail: Floating islands, and a paper Vero on a stick.

title: Enter
detail: Hold to enter. Leaving returns to that island.

title: Motion
detail: Chapters stay still. The traveler walks while the page scrolls. No motion switch.

title: Storybook
detail: Hand-drawn cutaway, from an elevated side view. Built in Cursor.

title: Two rooms
detail: The apartment and JPMC do not share a backdrop.

title: ChatGPT + ASTRA, then Cursor
detail: The plan was settled first. The page was built locally. No GitHub push at that point.
